sec: Histopathology, complications chain, prognostic scores and treatment

items.q: Histopathological features of alcoholic hepatitis: where is the fatty infiltration located?
Fill up the 'classical features' bullet: Ballooning degeneration / Alcoholic hyaline surrounding ______ infiltrate.
items.exp: 'Ballooning degeneration/Alcoholic hyaline surrounding polymorphonuclear infiltrate (Classical features)'. (Book p1028)

items.q: The Note under histopathology says which viral hepatitis shows fatty liver-like changes / hepatic steatosis?
items.exp: 'Note : Hepatitis C : fatty liver-like changes / hepatic steatosis.' (Book p1028)

items.q: What does the trichrome micrograph on p1028 illustrate, per its caption?
opts: Alcoholic hepatitis: nodules with fibrous septation
Primary sclerosing cholangitis: concentric periductal fibrosis
NASH: chicken-wire pericellular fibrosis of zone 3
NCPF: obliterative portal venopathy with sclerotic tracts
items.exp: Caption: 'Alcoholic hepatitis : Nodules with fibrous septation'. (Book p1028)

items.q: Fill up the complications chain: Alcoholic hepatitis → Fulminant hepatitis / Decompensated → Encephalopathy + Coagulopathy (Portal HTN) → ↑ ______ → Death.
items.exp: '… → Encephalopathy + Coagulopathy → ↑ ICT → Death', with 'Portal HTN' bracketed beneath. (Book p1028)

items.q: Discriminant factor (DF) — state the formula and poor-prognosis cut-off exactly as printed.
opts: 4.6 × (PT patient − PT control) + S. bilirubin; poor prognosis ≥ 32
items.exp: 'Discriminant factor : 4.6 × (PT(PE) − PT(C)) + S. bilirubin — Poor prognosis : ≥ 32'. (Book p1028)

items.q: Prognostic scores — match — 1) MELD 2) Glasgow 3) Discriminant factor … A) ≥ 32 B) ≥ 9 C) ≥ 18
Treatment: what is the printed indication for steroid in alcoholic hepatitis, and the regimen?
opts: DF score ≥ 32; 1 mg/kg × 7 days tapering over 3 weeks
MELD ≥ 18; 1 mg/kg/day × 4 weeks tapering over 12 weeks
items.exp: 'Indication to steroid : DF Score ≥ 32 → Start → 1 mg/kg × 7 days tapering over 3 weeks.' (Book p1028)

items.q: Which of the following is NOT printed as 'unfit for steroid'?
items.exp: Unfit for steroid: Sepsis; Renal failure; Ongoing GI disease. (Book p1028)

items.q: A binge drinker with DF 40 develops sepsis. Steroids are unsuitable. What alternative does the flowchart give, with its mechanism and dose?
opts: Pentoxifylline — inhibits TNF-α — 400 mg TDS × 4 weeks
Pentoxifylline — PDE-5 inhibitor — 400 mg OD × 1 week
items.exp: Unfit for steroid → Pentoxifylline: 'Inhibits TNF-α; 400 mg TDS × 4 weeks'. (Book p1028)
